description.summary: Note : This song deals with hero points.
description.value: Note : This song deals with hero points. See Hero Points for full details. Playing a heroic ballad, your targets are infused with the luck and fortune of heroes of old. Similarly to Ballad of the Hero , this song grants 1 hero point to each of the targets. This hero point must be spent before the duration expires, or it is lost. The bonus hero point is spent before any other hero points the targets might possess. This does not stack with Ballad of the Hero . The same target must wait until the end of the encounter or one minute before being affected again, whichever is longer.
